related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

observation.source_interface: mncs-env projections with authenticated campaign-state paging

outcome.analysis_limit: The direct projections route always started at the default newest page with a 32-reference page size. The authoritative campaign-state command could target offsets and smaller pages, but returned the ledger together with the derived projection. The pressure was an interface and response-focus limitation, not inability to access the records.

pressure_hypothesis.title: The direct capability projection cannot focus its bounded analysis on a selected ledger segment
pressure_hypothesis.basis: At checkpoint chk_21d3ee1b296d5c83 the bounded history projection left 37 observation records unread. Campaign-state paging could focus the derived view, while the dedicated projection command could not select the same offset and smaller page limit.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Allow the dedicated environmental-capability projection to start from an authenticated evidence offset and bounded page size, then reuse existing cursor and checkpoint-consistency checks without increasing the observation-read ceiling.
